stories.title: Rusland niet langer ‘de agressor’, maar ‘onze vijand’, zegt Yesilgöz

en.title: Russia no longer 'the aggressor', but 'our enemy', says Yesilgöz
en.summary: A Dutch political figure has stated that Russia should no longer be characterized as an aggressor but rather as an enemy, indicating a shift in official terminology regarding the country.

stories.title: Toon van kabinet wordt harder: 'Rusland is onze vijand'

en.title: Cabinet tone becomes harder: 'Russia is our enemy'
en.summary: The Dutch Defense Minister has stated that calling Russia an aggressor is no longer sufficient, declaring instead that Russia is an enemy of the Netherlands during a budget debate in parliament.

stories.title: Nobelprijs-laureaat Anne Carson laat zien dat het gevoel niet door het intellect is te verslaan

en.title: Nobel Prize laureate Anne Carson shows that feeling cannot be defeated by intellect
en.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson, a Nobel Prize winner, creates work drawing from classical antiquity and has been recognized by the Nobel Committee for her innovative approaches to contemporary literature.

stories.title: Van Gogh Museum kan met renovatie beginnen na geslaagde bemiddeling over subsidie

en.title: Van Gogh Museum can begin renovation after successful negotiation over subsidy
en.summary: The Van Gogh Museum has secured the ability to proceed with a renovation project following successful negotiations regarding funding.

stories.title: Zeven omroepen vragen NPO om opheldering over deelname Songfestival

en.title: Seven broadcasters ask NPO for clarification on Song Contest participation
en.summary: Seven broadcasters are requesting clarification from NPO regarding the Netherlands' participation in the Eurovision Song Contest, including questions about funding sources and withdrawal conditions.

stories.title: Politie deelt tientallen boetes uit om filmen van ongeluk A58 bij Oirschot

en.title: Police issue dozens of fines for filming accident on A58 near Oirschot
en.summary: Police fined 29 drivers for recording footage of a serious accident on the A58 highway while driving. The incident left two people injured and prompted a temporary road closure.

stories.title: Yesilgöz noemt Rusland nu 'de vijand' maar dat betekent 'niet ineens andere aanpak'

en.title: Yesilgöz now calls Russia 'the enemy' but says it means 'not suddenly a different approach'
en.summary: Defense Minister Yesilgöz shifted her terminology regarding Russia from "aggressor" to "enemy" during parliamentary budget discussions, citing increasing sabotage and drone threats, though she clarified this does not signal a policy change.

stories.title: Den Haag is akkoord na slepende vete, Van Gogh Museum kan gaan renoveren

en.title: The Hague agrees after prolonged dispute, Van Gogh Museum can proceed with renovation
en.summary: The Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science reached an agreement with the Van Gogh Museum on renovation financing, resolving a long-standing dispute over the museum's future improvements.

stories.title: Tientallen mensen beboet voor filmen ernstig ongeluk op A58 bij Oirschot

en.title: Dozens of people fined for filming serious accident on A58 near Oirschot
en.summary: Police issued fines to 29 drivers who used their phones to film the aftermath of a serious accident on the A58 highway near Oirschot. Traffic police stated the behavior violated basic standards of decency.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor Canadese dichter en hoogleraar klassieke talen Anne Carson

en.title: Nobel Prize in Literature awarded to Canadian poet and classics professor Anne Carson
en.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson, 76, received the Nobel Prize in Literature for her distinctive blend of classical style with contemporary writing. She is recognized for her poetry, translations of classical Greek texts, and decades of academic work in classics.

stories.title: Canadese classicus Anne Carson wint Nobelprijs voor Literatuur

en.title: Canadian classicist Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Canadian poet and classics scholar Anne Carson has won the Nobel Prize in Literature.

stories.title: Van Gogh Museum en ministerie OCW bereiken akkoord over financiering grootschalige renovatie

en.title: Van Gogh Museum and OCW ministry reach agreement on major renovation funding
en.summary: The Van Gogh Museum and the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science have reached an agreement over financing for a major renovation project after a dispute that began in 2023. Specific terms of the agreement have not been disclosed.
